text: Evidence validation is explicit: `dogfood-status.json` must report top-level `status: "ok"`, empty `data.issues`, and `data.runtime.status: "idle"`; `dogfood-sync.json` must be `ok` and include `distill`, `apply`, `verify`, and `export`; `dogfood-verify.json` and `dogfood-replay.json` must be `ok` with non-empty result arrays; `dogfood-drift.txt` must contain `drift: ok` and must not contain `POLICY_DENIED`.
